## Summary

Implements issue #106: registers the `journal-inbox` view type and caches each Journal day's related Inbox items in `items.computed`, invalidating/recomputing after capture, proposal transitions, and deletion.

- **`views/journalInboxViewType.ts`**: registers the `journal-inbox` view type (config: `inboxDatabaseId`, `journalDayRelationKey`, `computedKey`), following the same registration pattern as the existing `temporal-switcher`/`mailbox-client` view types.
- **`inbox/journalInboxCompute.ts`**: the computed-cache mechanism — declares `JOURNAL_INBOX_COMPUTED_KEY = "inboxItems"`, builds a canonical, display-ready list of Inbox items scoped to one Journal day purely via the `journalDay` relation (excluding soft-deleted items, resolving each item's type and current proposal status as raw canonical values, not localized text), and writes/invalidates it through `writeComputed`/`notifyInvalidation` — mirroring the existing rollup engine's enqueue/recompute pattern with a new deduped `journalInboxRecompute` graphile-worker task.
- Wired the new task into `@semprec/queue`'s `CORE_TASK_NAMES` and `worker.ts`; declared the computed key and registered the view type during seeding (`seedInboxPipeline.ts`/`seedSystem.ts`).
- Hooked recompute triggers into all three required invalidation points: capture (`inboxStore.ts`), update/deletion (`inboxTickAction.ts`'s tick handler — a soft-deleted item's relation edge still resolves), and proposal transitions (`proposalActions.ts`'s confirm/reject/revise).
- Deliberately did not persist a `journal-inbox` view row during seeding since no Journal frontend exists yet in this repo, and doing so would have collided with existing tests asserting exactly one view per seeded database.
- Added `__tests__/journalInboxCompute.test.ts` (8 tests) covering view-type registration, computed-key collision guarding, day-scoping, type/status resolution, and cache updates after capture, confirm, reject, and deletion.

Verified: full workspace build (`pnpm -r run build`) clean; full test suite (`npx vitest run`) 321/321 tests passed.

## Summary

Pushed the review-response commit for PR #290 (issue #106, "Render Inbox items inside Journal days"). Since the remote branch had picked up a `develop` merge in the meantime, I rebased my commit on top of it before pushing — build and full test suite (backend 322/322, web 79/79) re-verified clean after the rebase.

This push addresses the automated code review's findings:
- **Medium finding (architecture)**: `computedKeyRegistry.add(JOURNAL_INBOX_COMPUTED_KEY)` was only reached inside a one-time seed path skipped after first startup; hoisted to `seedSystem.ts`'s top level so the collision guard is declared on every process start.
- **Medium finding (test coverage)**: added a test covering the revise-triggered cache invalidation path.
- **Acceptance-criteria gaps**: registered a real `JournalInboxList` frontend renderer under the `journalInboxList` client component, added en/cs i18n catalog entries for the view's states and canonical proposal statuses, and made `journalDayItemId` part of the view's own config so it's actually renderable.

This push addresses the automated code review's remaining blocking findings:
- **HIGH**: `JournalInboxList.tsx` cast the cached `computed` payload without runtime validation. Added a Zod schema (`journalInboxItemSummarySchema`/`journalInboxItemListSchema`) and parse it inside the async loader, so a malformed payload surfaces through the existing error/retry UI instead of rendering garbage.
- **MEDIUM**: added a test covering the error-state/retry branch and the new schema-validation failure path.
- Also cleaned up a flagged low-priority comment in `inboxTickAction.ts` that mischaracterized which invalidation trigger the tick-driven recompute call actually covers.
